assessment: This important article reports functional interactions between L1TD1, an RNA-binding protein (RBP), and its ancestral LINE-1 retrotransposon, which is not modulated at the translational level. The evidence for the association between L1TD1 and LINE-1 ORF1p is solid. The work implies that the transposon-derived RNA-binding protein in the human genome can interact with the ancestral transposable element from which this protein was initially derived. This work spurs interesting questions for cancer types, where LINE1 and L1TD1 are aberrantly expressed.
